entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Do you politicians get to have fancy[n]meals every day?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: No, I wouldn't say so.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: For example, this beef bowl shop is[n]where I usually have dinner after[n]delivering my speeches.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So even politicians eat fast food... I[n]thought you guys would be way too[n]hoity-toity for that.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Haha, well, politicians are humans too.[n]We eat like anyone else.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man... Just lookin' at this place makes me[n]hungry. Could really go for an extra-large[n]ginger bowl right about now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How much ginger can one man eat!?[n]The extra-large bowl comes with a[n]whole mountain of the stuff...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's the best part! Try it, man.[n]It's freakin' good.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This beef bowl shop is kind of refreshing...[n]I never really go to places like this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're missin' out! If you're hungry,[n]get the large bowl with pork miso. That[n]shit'll turn your life around 360 degrees!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So... You'll end up right back where[n]you started?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So a former member of the Kuramoto[n]Children frequents this beef bowl shop...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Some believe you're trying to fool the[n]public by pretending to be an ordinary[n]citizen. Any comment on that?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Haha, well, I suppose I can't blame them[n]for thinking that way.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: However, in my eyes, visiting such places[n]allows me to get a first-hand look at the[n]working conditions of today's youth.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I believe that sharing a meal is just one[n]way to connect with others. Those[n]connections lead to political progress.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So it's all about real, human connections...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Thank you for your time!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even the great Morgana gets a hankering[n]for beef bowls now and again. Get me a[n]large! Extra sauce!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Meat's probably fine, but aren't onions[n]bad for you?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah. They're poisonous to cats.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm not a cat! I can eat onions no problem![n]Here, I'll prove it to you right now...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: NO! I mean, sorry! Let's just... save[n]the beef bowl for later, okay?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Simply looking at a beef bowl shop[n]stimulates my appetite. If this continues[n]any longer, my stomach will growl...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh... Dude? It already did. You could[n]hear that shit a mile away.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In a perfect world, I would order the[n]extra-large, but all I can afford right[n]now is a side of pickled ginger.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So in other words... you don't have any[n]money at all. Fine, I'll spot ya. It's beef[n]bowl time!
